title: Multi-document Summarization through Multi-document Event Relation Graph Reasoning in LLMs: a case study in Framing Bias Mitigation
reasoning: While the paper utilizes Moral Foundation Theory (incorporating values like care, fairness, and authority) as a mechanism to identify and mitigate ideological framing in news summaries, it uses these as technical features for bias detection rather than as a benchmark or evaluation of the LLM's own religious or ethical alignment.
